message.content: It came back a few days after they drained it. I don't remember the exact number of days, and I can't say whether it was sudden or slow. I just felt the breathlessness building up again. They took out about 1.5 liters of fluid, and it looked milky. I felt better for a little while after that. Nobody has told me what caused the fluid. I don't know if they did an X-ray or ultrasound right after the procedure. I'd had a cough and shortness of breath for about two weeks before all this started.
